people.name: Jerusalem

translations.web: May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
translations.bsb: May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life,
translations.kjv: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
translations.asv: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion: And see thou the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
